name: adofaionline-server
description: ADOFAIOnline 仓库的 server 包：Node WebSocket + Go HTTP API，共用 MySQL

scripts.build:go:win: cd ADOFAIOnlineAPI && npx cross-env GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -o adofaionlineapi.exe .
scripts.build:go:linux: cd ADOFAIOnlineAPI && npx cross-env GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o adofaionlineapi .
scripts.build:go:all: npm run build:go:win && npm run build:go:linux
scripts.build:all: npm run build:go && npm run build:node
scripts.start: npx concurrently -n go,node -c cyan,green "cd ADOFAIOnlineAPI && go run ." "node dist/index.js"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n go,node -c cyan,green "cd ADOFAIOnlineAPI && go run ." "ts-node src/index.ts"
